FULL.audit: scripts/fill_full.py from `results/analysis/analysis_confirm.json`: Assumption audit at theta_0 (B5, B6, A0); prereg v1.3 sec. 4.3 (secondary; the labels are reported with C1, no decision depends on them, and the audit enters no confirmatory statistic); labels verbatim as registered, except that the analysis string 'A0 violated', which the pre-registration does not name, is printed as 'A0 does not hold approximately' (the complement of the registered label 'A0 approximately holds'): registered quantities and labels only, no interpretation beyond the registered one. B5: interaction share of the two-way decomposition log Q_c(g) = a_g + b_c + e_gc per base after subtracting the expected noise contribution, with its 95% window-bootstrap interval (2,000 resamples); cells with Q <= 0 counted, reported and excluded; labels below 0.1 'approximately separable', 0.1 to 0.3 'moderately non-separable', above 0.3 'non-separable'. B6, per subset: CV of exp(a_g) over its 12 groups and Spearman rho between a_g and the group's share of P with its bootstrap interval; 'homogeneous' if CV < 0.25, 'heterogeneous, uncorrelated' if CV >= 0.25 and the interval of rho contains 0, otherwise 'heterogeneous, correlated', which the pre-registration names as the case that biases P; Jensen gap reported. A0: median of r = |gamma_c(g)|/Q_c(g) and share of cells with r >= 0.2 per base and corpus; 'A0 approximately holds' if that share is at most 0.25. Each value stated once, in Table tab:fullaudit; the bootstrap interval of the CV that the frozen code also writes is not a registered quantity and is not printed. The bases follow the A-3 record, and a base without outputs is reported as missing; the fill stops on a structure other than the registered one, on a disagreement with the A-3 record and on a label that differs from the registered rule applied to its numbers
